description: This file defines a class '_ProxyDBLogger' with methods for asynchronously logging success and failure events related to cost tracking in a proxy server environment. It includes functions for deciding whether to track cost callbacks, handling database updates, and error handling, specifically for cost tracking and metrics within the 'litellm' proxy infrastructure.
